cliEngine.description: High-performance Node.js / TypeScript terminal CLI for managing daemon, workspace initialization, and desktop GUI.

commands.name: aevum --help
commands.purpose: Display CLI usage manual, options, and commands.

commands.name: aevum --version
commands.purpose: Display current version, Node.js runtime, and system architecture.

commands.name: aevum status
commands.purpose: Ping running daemon via /api/ping to display uptime, active persona, and workspace path.

commands.name: aevum init [dir]
commands.purpose: Scaffold .aevum/ architecture vault, rules, signal tokens, and starter personas in target directory.

commands.name: aevum-gui
commands.purpose: Standalone helper alias to start GUI web dashboard directly.
